sections.label: Head
Eyes
sections.text:
Distressing photophobia. [Conium.] Spots
before eyes. Stitches in eyebrow. Sore eyeballs.

sections.label: Ears
sections.text:
Inflammation about auricle. Deep ulcerated
auricle. Eczema around ear.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Pain in liver on pressure. Colic below
navel. Pain in sigmoid flexure and rectum. Painful,
bleeding, protruding piles.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Violent dyspnoea, oppression of chest
with trembling. Pain about bifurcation of trachea.
Asthma in scrofulous patients.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text: Prickling itching, worse back of hand.

sections.label: Sleep
sections.text:
Great drowsiness; in morning and before
and after meals with weariness.
